A little story, made for you

For You

Before you look at the pictures, I want you to know that every word here is meant for you.

A birthday letter in photographs

Her story.My favorite one.

Happy Birthday, my love.
Scroll slowly
01 / THE BEGINNING
Long before I knew you
The first page of your story

Before you became my person.

There was a little girl here who had no idea that one day she would become one of the most beautiful parts of someone's life. She did not know that years later, someone would look at her and feel incredibly lucky just because she existed.

I wish I could go back to this little version of you and tell her everything. Tell her that she would grow into a woman with a smile that can change the whole mood of a room, a heart that deserves to be protected, and a place in someone's life that could never be replaced.

And somehow, out of all the people in the world, life brought that little girl to me. I will always be grateful for that.

I didn't fall in love with one photograph. I fell in love with every version of you.

02 / YOUR EYES
The eyes I could never forget
The part of you that stays with me

Your eyes have a way of making everything else disappear.

There is something about your eyes that I honestly cannot explain. I can look at them for a second and suddenly forget what I was saying, what I was thinking, and sometimes even what I was worried about.

They are beautiful in a way that is not just about how they look. They carry your softness, your confidence, your little emotions, and all those tiny expressions that I notice even when you think I don't.

And if I ever had to choose one thing to look at when the world feels too loud, I think I would choose your eyes every single time. They feel familiar. They feel like you. And somehow, they feel like home to me.

03 / THE SEA
You, the sea, and a moment I love
If beauty had a place

Even the sea looks quieter beside you.

There are pictures that look beautiful, and then there are pictures that make you stop for a moment. This one is one of those pictures for me.

You standing there with the sea behind you made me think about how unfairly beautiful you can be without even trying. The night, the waves, the lights, everything around you was beautiful, but somehow my eyes still went straight to you.

I love the way you look when you are simply being yourself. I love your smile, your face, your eyes, your little details, and even the things you probably don't think are special. To me, they are exactly what makes you you.

Some people become memories. You became my favorite part of the present.

04 / THE LITTLE MOMENTS
One more reason to smile
The moments I keep

I could fill a thousand pages with little things I love about you.

The way you smile when you are genuinely happy. The way you talk about things you care about. The little reactions you make without noticing. The way one ordinary moment can become special simply because you are in it.

I don't need every day with you to be perfect. I just want it to be ours. The quiet days, the funny days, the complicated days, the days when we laugh for no reason and the days when we simply sit together.

05 / YOU
Simply you
What I see

You are more beautiful than you realize.

Sometimes I wish you could see yourself through my eyes for just one minute. Maybe then you would understand why I stare at you a little longer, why your pictures make me smile, and why I can never get tired of telling you how beautiful you are.

But your beauty is only one part of why I love you. I love the person behind it. I love the way you make me feel, the comfort you bring me, and the fact that somehow you have become someone I genuinely want beside me for the long run.

06 / ANOTHER MEMORY
A moment worth keeping
Us, in the little details

My favorite memories are the ones where you are simply there.

I don't think love is only about grand gestures. I think it lives in the small things: remembering a conversation, noticing a mood, missing someone's voice, wanting to tell them every little thing that happened during the day.

And somehow, you became the person I want to share those little things with.

07 / THE BEAUTIFUL YOU
Still my favorite view
One thing I know

I will never get tired of choosing you.

There are so many beautiful people and so many different lives we could have lived. But I love the life where our paths crossed. I love the story that started between us, and I want to keep writing it.

Whatever comes next, I hope I get to be there for it. More birthdays. More photographs. More late conversations. More ordinary days that somehow become our favorite memories.

08 / TODAY
Today, and every day after
The last photograph, not the last page

And somehow, I love you more.

More than I did yesterday. More than I knew I could when this story started. And I hope that years from now, when we look back at these pictures, we will laugh at how young we were and smile because we made it through every chapter together.

This is not the end of our story. It is just another beautiful page.
